text: When testing `tomlkit.dumps`, be mindful of expected newline characters. The `tomlkit.dumps` function often adds an extra newline at the end of sections or documents, which can lead to subtle assertion failures if not accounted for in the expected string.
Do not import `torch` in tests; it is not a dependency of `tomlkit` and will cause `ModuleNotFoundError`.
Tests should be placed in `tomlkit/tests/` and follow the naming convention `test_*.py`.
